mapper.select: SELECT l.tenant_id AS tenantId, s.name AS modelName, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(s.input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(s.input_tokens), 0) + COALESCE(SUM(s.output_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens FROM cw_agent_call_log l INNER JOIN cw_agent_call_segment s ON s.call_log_id = l.id AND s.kind = 'MODEL' WHERE l.created_at >= #{statDate} AND l.created_at < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY l.tenant_id, s.name

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, provider AS provider, model_name AS modelName, COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM cw_tenant_usage_daily WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY tenant_id, provider, model_name ORDER BY amount DESC

SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId, COALESCE(SUM(call_count), 0) AS callCount, COALESCE(SUM(input_tokens), 0) AS inputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(output_tokens), 0) AS outputTokens, COALESCE(SUM(cached_tokens), 0) AS cachedTokens, COALESCE(SUM(total_tokens), 0) AS totalTokens, COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS amount FROM cw_tenant_usage_daily WHERE stat_date BETWEEN #{from} AND #{to} GROUP BY tenant_id ORDER BY amount DESC
